title: US Foods to Host First Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call and Webcast
summary: US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD) will host a live conference call and webcast to discuss first quarter 2026 results on Thursday, May 7, 2026, at 8 a.m. CDT. The conference call can be accessed live over the phone by dialing 877-344-2001. Listeners should dial in 10 minutes prior to the call start time and provide the Conference ID 2528845 to be connected. A replay will be available after the call. To listen to a replay of the conference call, please register by clicking this link . The conference call also will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.usfoods.com . The presentation slides that will be reviewed during the webcast will be available in the Events Presentations section of the Investor Relations website before the webcast begins. An archive of the webcast will be available at the same location beginning at 12 p.m. CDT on May 7, 2026.
